status: conditional compensation candidate motivated by prior pilot; saved before these transporter values/associations are inspected
hypothesis: Insufficient alternative phosphate handling may condition epithelial stress after SLC34A2 impairment; RNA associations are only descriptive prerequisites, not flux tests.
selection_rule: Reuse exact archived library+barcode selection memberships without adapting any marker/QC thresholds; recover from raw matrices; require matching archived total UMI and unique symbols/stable IDs.
comparison: PAM minus control difference of library summaries; no cell-derived p-values, biological CI or tissue composition estimate

associations.pairs: each of SLC20A1,SLC20A2 versus each of KRT8,SPRR1A,CLU within each library and selection separately
methods: partial rank correlation after residualizing both ranked variables on ranked total UMI and ranked detected-gene count
associations.coverage: at least 50 cells and both genes detected in >=20 cells and >=5% of selected cells; otherwise report not_estimable
associations.depth_controls: report each variable versus total UMI and n_genes, including for all primary and secondary pairs
associations.scope: cell associations describe a sampled library, not biological replication, compensation or within-cell causal effects

decision: Concordant negative depth-conditional associations could nominate linked mechanistic follow-up only; inconsistent/missing associations weaken use of transporter RNA as a buffering surrogate. Neither direction tests actual compensatory flux.
limits: one case and one control; age/disease/donor inseparable
source mouse assays are unlinked to human cells
no timing, restoration or mature function
